name: Demo G5: Move-Like Redline Family Instance
description: Exercise a move-like redline operation using a disposable modeled family-instance target: create a bounded device/fixture-like element, prove its requested type and initial location, move it with native dry-run/apply evidence, prove the model-space delta, write a deterministic visual gate, and clean it up.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view, level, and non-hosted or level-hosted family type that can be safely placed, moved, and deleted.
Prefer a generic annotation, receptacle, light fixture, or other disposable benchmark symbol available in the active model.
success_criteria: A disposable family instance id is created in the model.
The native create result returns family/type/name evidence matching the requested disposable symbol.
The created family instance id is visible in the pre-move visible-element inventory with a model-space point.
Native move dry-run and apply evidence include the created family instance id.
The post-move visible-element inventory contains the same id at the requested model-space delta.
A deterministic move visual gate artifact passes using before/after capture evidence.
The moved family instance is cleaned up with native dry-run and applied delete effect evidence.
failure_criteria: The family instance is not created or is created as a different requested type.
The before/after visible-element inventory cannot prove the requested movement vector.
Move dry-run or apply omits the family instance id from effect evidence.
The move visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
Cleanup delete dry-run/apply omits the family instance id from effect evidence.
grader_notes: This task generalizes move-like redline evidence beyond text and tags into actual modeled family instances.
Do not count requestedIds-only move or cleanup responses as evidence; move/delete must return ids, movedIds, deletedIds, or impactedIds as appropriate.
